item.title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

item.tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

answer_sheet.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
answer_sheet.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
answer_sheet.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
answer_sheet.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

must_haves: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.

steps.why: Create the opening rooftop scene with room for a portrait crop.

steps.why: Create a complementary detail shot for the second half.
